commit.message:
fleet-hooks: fail-closed credential key-scan pre-commit + setup + 11/11 test battery

Productizes the wave-52 house practice (rg "ghp_|gho_|github_pat_" on staged
files before every push) into a self-enforcing git hook.

- .githooks/pre-commit: scans staged INDEX blobs (git grep --cached), not the
  worktree; deletions excluded; binaries skipped (documented blind spot);
  .git/* + node_modules/* excluded; report = class + file:line, matched content
  never echoed; FLEET_ALLOW=<ERE> line-granular escape hatch (loud, per-run);
  control-char filenames fail closed; exit 0/1/2 (pass/violation/scan-error).
- setup.sh: arms core.hooksPath .githooks, fail-closed if hook file missing,
  smoke-scans the current index.
- tests/test_hooks.sh: 11/11 controls (positive/negative/escape/binary/deletion/
  multi-class/node_modules/newline/setup) in throwaway repos; fixtures built at
  runtime from obviously-fake chars (ghp_ + 36 x) so the source is scan-clean.
- README.md: install one-liner, design law, wave-52 provenance, honest limits.

Scan classes: ghp_/gho_/ghs_/ghu_ (36), github_pat_ (22+), sk-ant prefix, AKIA+16.
No network, stdlib-only POSIX sh. Identity: SuperInstance <fleet@superinstance.dev>.
